instruction: Named fields containing a hyphen, such as '/local/sub/{user-id}/duration', are not recognised by parse. Allow hyphens in field names. Results must be available under the original name (result['user-id']). Regex group names cannot contain '-', so map it the same way '.' and '[]' are already mapped, including the existing collision handling: for the template '/foo/{user-id}/{user_id}/{user.id}/bar/' Parser(template).named_fields must be ['user_id', 'user__id', 'user___id'], and parsing '/foo/1/2/3/bar/' gives result['user-id'] == '1', result['user_id'] == '2' and result['user.id'] == '3'. Add tests.
notes: addopts cleared: the repo .pytest.ini requests pytest-cov coverage options, which are not part of the benchmark environment
